changes.title: Boot freeze
items: The game no longer freezes for up to a minute ("Page Unresponsive") while it loads: the treehouse's floor is painted in the background

changes.title: Leave undressed
items: Once you're up you can leave the bedroom in your nightie: getting dressed is up to you
A hat picked up from the Cloakroom floor goes straight on her head

changes.title: Boot bedroom
items: A link with a seed or an island in it now wakes her in her treehouse bedroom too, not the character creator
